source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag 9.2 Cu. Ft. Steam Dryer Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Verify ACU green LED
steps.body: Power on — center green LED on ACU should flash then stay lit. If UI works but LED never wakes, suspect UI hibernate/wake path.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power on — center green LED on ACU should flash then stay lit. If UI works but LED never wakes, suspect UI hibernate/wake path.

steps.title: Verify outlet voltage
steps.body: Electric: 240/208 VAC. Gas: 120 VAC. Time-delay fuse required on electric.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electric: 240/208 VAC. Gas: 120 VAC. Time-delay fuse required on electric.

steps.title: Access ACU
steps.body: Remove console. Restore power only for live voltage steps below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove console. Restore power only for live voltage steps below.

images.caption: Removing top panel and console/HMI (W11737351 p.8)

steps.title: 120 VAC at J8-3 (N) and J9-2 (L1)
steps.body: Use needle probes. Black to J8-3, red to J9-2 — expect 120 VAC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Use needle probes. Black to J8-3, red to J9-2 — expect 120 VAC.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: No L1 at ACU — perform TEST #2 supply connections.

steps.title: +5 VDC at J2-1 vs J2-3 (J2 unplugged)
steps.body: Unplug J2 from ACU. DC volts: red J2-1, black J2-3. Missing +5V with J14 unplugged → shorted thermistor (TEST #4a).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug J2 from ACU. DC volts: red J2-1, black J2-3. Missing +5V with J14 unplugged → shorted thermistor (TEST #4a).

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Diagnose thermistor short or harness before replacing ACU.

steps.title: Thermistor short isolation
steps.body: Disconnect power. Unplug J14, restore power, retest +5 VDC. If +5 returns, run TEST #4a thermistors.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Unplug J14, restore power, retest +5 VDC. If +5 returns, run TEST #4a thermistors.

steps.title: UI harness isolation
steps.body: Reconnect J14. Leave J2 unplugged. Retest +5 VDC at J2 header pins 1 & 3 (do not short pins). If +5 returns, check ACU↔UI harness; replace UI if harness OK.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect J14. Leave J2 unplugged. Retest +5 VDC at J2 header pins 1 & 3 (do not short pins). If +5 returns, check ACU↔UI harness; replace UI if harness OK.

steps.title: ACU power verified
steps.oemOutcome: Line and +5 VDC present at ACU.
